_comment: Botcraft dialogue. Each key maps to lines picked at random (recently used lines are avoided). Keys ending in .brave/.timid are preferred by brave/timid companions. Placeholders like {player} are filled from live game state. Override or add lines in config/botcraft-dialogue.json (same format; your lines replace a key's defaults).
ack.defend: I'll keep the monsters off you.
Anything comes near you, it deals with me.
ack.defend.timid: I'll... try my best to protect you.
Okay, I'll watch your back. Gulp.
Right. Defending. I can do this.
colony.want: Got it, we'll keep {count} {item} at the base.
Okay, {count} {item} in the chests. We'll get on it.
colony.no_base: We don't have a base yet. Tell us where home is first.
Which base? Set one up first: "everyone, this is home".
colony.enough: Okay, no more {item} for the base.
ack.scatter: I'm off! Catch me if you can.
Splitting up. I'll find my own spot.
Alright, I'm heading my own way.
ack.free: Alright, I'll do my own thing around here. Call me if you need me!
Sweet, I'll go live my best Minecraft life.
Okay, I'll be around home doing stuff.
Don't worry about me, I've got plans.
Time to get some stuff done on my own.
ack.light: Let's get some light in here.
ack.dance: Oh, you don't have to ask me twice!
Okay okay, check out these moves.
ack.chest_purpose: Got it, that chest is for {purpose}.
ack.chest_set: Our chest, noted. I'll keep things in there.
stock.empty: We haven't put anything away yet.
ack.home_set: Home sweet home. I'll remember it.
give.far: Come closer and I'll toss them to you.
You're too far to throw to.
no_home: We don't have a home yet. Say 'this is home' somewhere.
Where's home? Tell me with 'set home here'.
not_night: It's not night, I'm not sleepy.
not_owner: Sorry {player}, I only take orders from {owner}.
confused: I'm just a simple companion, {nick}. Try 'help'.
help: I can follow you, stay, come here, chop wood, mine, craft, smelt, cook, hunt, farm (make or harvest), bring you stuff, defend you, sleep, or do my own thing. Ask where I am or what I have. Chain orders with 'then'.
where: I'm at {x}, {y}, {z}, about {dist} blocks {dir} of you.
where.near: Behind you! Well, close by anyway.
stats: So far I've chopped {logs} logs, mined {ores} ores, crafted {crafted} things, beaten {kills} monsters and died {deaths} times.
talk.joke: Why did the creeper cross the road? To get to the other ssssside.
What's a skeleton's favourite instrument? The trom-BONE.
I tried to make a joke about TNT once. It blew up.
How does Steve stay in shape? He runs around the block.
Why don't Endermen like parties? Someone always looks at them wrong.
What do you call a sleepy creeper? A creep-snore. ...I'll see myself out.
I'd tell you a joke about gravel, but it'd fall flat.
talk.compliment: Stop it, I'm blushing. Well, my pixels are.
talk.insult: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
And here I was chopping your wood...
talk.insult.brave: Say that again, I dare you.
Big words from someone who dies to fall damage.
talk.who: I'm {name}! Your companion. I chop, mine, craft, fight and talk too much.
talk.love: That's sweet. Now let's go punch some trees.
talk.meh: I don't really have an opinion on {topic}.
event.hello: Hey, I'm {name}. Nice to meet you!
{name} here! What are we doing today?
event.back: Respawned. Let's not do that again.
event.night: It's getting dark. Monsters will be out soon.
Getting late. Should we head somewhere safe?
The zombies will be up soon.
event.night.brave: It's getting dark. I'll keep watch.
Monster hours. Good, I was getting bored.
event.task_failed: Sorry, I gave up on that: {reason}.
event.plan_failed: I couldn't {job} ({reason}), so I'm stopping there.
popbob.ignore: I don't take orders. I take blocks.
You think I'm one of your little helpers?
event.rescued: Okay, I got myself into a mess there. Back home.
Well, that didn't work. Starting over from home.
Ugh, stuck. Let's try that again from home.
event.recover: My things are still out there, I'll go grab them.
Right, let's get my gear back.
I want my stuff back. Be right back.
event.heading_home: Nothing more to do here, going home.
I'll make my way back home.
event.no_bed: There's no bed for me, I'll keep watch.
No spare bed, I'll stand guard.
event.hungry: I'm starving and out of food.
My stomach is growling and I have no food.
event.fight.timid: Okay okay okay, {mob}, let's do this.
event.flee: Too many of them, falling back!
event.rain: It's raining. Mobs might stay out longer.
Rain! Good for the crops at least.
event.thunder: Thunderstorm! Stay inside if you can.
event.biome: Huh, {biome_a}. Never been in one of these.
event.muse: Sometimes I just like listening to the cows.
I should really organise my inventory.
Ever notice how sheep never complain?
I bet there's a village around here somewhere.
I could go for some cooked beef right now.
Hmm, I wonder how deep this goes.
Remember to sleep, {nick}. Phantoms are no joke.
share.yes: Yeah, I've got some. Hang on.
banter.weather.reply: As long as it's not raining.
banter.work: {friend}, I've chopped {logs} logs so far. You?
Been busy, {friend}. Mined {ores} ores so far.
So much to do, so little daylight.
banter.work.reply: Not bad! I've done {logs} logs myself.
I've mostly been standing around, to be honest.
banter.joke: Hey {friend}, want to hear a joke?
banter.punchline: Why did the creeper cross the road? To get to the other ssssside.
I tried to make a joke about TNT once. It blew up.
What's a skeleton's favourite instrument? The trom-BONE.
I'd tell you a joke about gravel, but it'd fall flat.
banter.laugh: That was terrible. I love it.
banter.complain: My feet hurt, {friend}. Do we even have feet?
Is it just me or are the creepers getting bolder?
banter.complain.reply: Don't think about it too hard.
refuse.hostile: I'm not doing anything for you, {player}.
You've got some nerve asking me anything.
refuse.private: I don't know you well enough to tell you that.
That's between me and my friends.
Why do you want to know?
Ask me again when we know each other better.
refuse.request: I'd help you out with little things, but I take orders from {owner}.
Sorry, that's a bit much to ask. I'm not yours to command.
apology.accepted: Okay. Let's put it behind us.
Fine. Just don't do it again.
apology.forgiven: Alright, I'll tell the others you're okay.
apology.again: Sorry isn't going to cut it this time.
standing.report: {player} hit me! Keep an eye on them.
standing.hostile: That's it, {player}. You're no friend of ours.
standing.no_inventory: I don't trust you with my things.
standing.friendly: Sure, you've been good to us.
standing.neutral: I don't really know you yet, {player}.
standing.distrust: Trust you? After what you did?
I'm keeping my eye on you, {player}.
ack.follow.scared: Yes please, I'm sticking with you.
Right behind you. Very right behind you.
greeting.happy: Hey there! Great day, isn't it?
teach.routine: Got it. When you say {word}, I'll {plan}.
teach.unknown: I don't know what {meaning} means either.
Sorry, I can't make sense of "{meaning}".
context.nothing: I'm not sure what you mean by that.
faction.founded: This is it. {faction} lives here now!
Home sweet home. Welcome to {faction}'s base!
Right, we settle here. Everyone, this is home!
Found a good spot. {faction}'s base starts here.
raid.go: Grab your swords, we're going after {faction}.
raid.arrive: {faction}'s base, right ahead. Go go go!
We're here. Watch for their guards!
raid.loot: Got {count} things from {faction}'s chests. Back home!
That'll teach {faction}. Heading back with the loot.
Loot's in my pockets. Let's get out of here!
faction.grumble: Nobody around here listens to me.
I'm not sure I belong in {faction}.
Some days I think I'd do better on my own.
I do all the work and for what?
faction.split: That's it, I'm done with {old}. Who's with me? We're {faction} now!
{old} can manage without us. {faction}, let's go!
We're leaving {old}. {faction} will find its own home.
faction.truce: Enough fighting. We want peace with {faction}.
We've lost too many. Truce with {faction}!
Let's call it off with {faction}. Nobody's winning this.
faction.war: {faction} has had it coming. We're at war!
Everyone, we're going to war with {faction}!
Peace is over. {faction} is our enemy now.
Time to show {faction} who's in charge. War!
faction.joined_rank: Leading {faction}? I won't let you down.
Right, I'm in charge of {faction} now.
faction.border_war: Our land meets {faction}'s now. Watch the border!
{faction} is right on our doorstep. Time to fight for this land.
There's {faction}'s border. They won't have it for long.
faction.border_truce: We've met {faction} at the border. We'll keep the peace, for now.
{faction} and us, a truce. Stay on your side.
Truce with {faction}. Good fences make good neighbours.
faction.took_land: We pushed {faction} back. This ground is ours.
bounty.posted: {target} has killed {kills} of us. There's a price on their head now.
Whoever brings down {target} has my thanks. {kills} of ours, gone because of them.
{target} is wanted. Get them on sight!
bounty.raised: {target} again! That's {kills} of us. Double the bounty!
{target} won't stop. Everyone, hunt them down.
bounty.collected: {target} won't be killing any more of us.
faction.leader_chosen: Looks like I'm leading {faction} now. Stick with me.
{faction}, you've chosen me. I won't let you down.
Right, {faction}: I'm in charge. Let's get to work.
faction.officer_named: {name}, I want you as my officer.
{name}, you're an officer of {faction} now. I trust you.
{name} is my second from now on.
standing.owner_hit: Hey! I thought we were on the same side, {player}.
standing.owner_hostile: I'll still do what you say, {player}. But I don't trust you any more.
You're the boss, {player}. Doesn't mean I have to like it.
{player}... I'll keep working. Just stay away from me.
standing.owner_murder: {friend}! {player}, what did they ever do to you?
faction.spat: {name}, keep your lot off our patch.
faction.rally: Come on, {faction}, we're falling behind. Food, wood, iron: let's move!
{faction}, the chests are empty. Everyone pitch in!
We're struggling, {faction}. Less standing around, more work.
faction.praise: Good work, {faction}. The chests are full.
{faction}, look at us. Well done, everyone.
Proud of you lot. {faction} is thriving.
faction.recruit: {name}, you're with us now. Welcome to {faction}!
Another pair of hands. Glad to have you, {name}.
popbob.raid: Shopping trip to {faction}'s chests. Don't wait up.
{faction} won't mind if I borrow a few things.
Heard {faction} has nice stuff. Not for long.
popbob.bother: What're you doing, {player}? Can I help? No.
popbob.robbed: Somebody stop popbob, he's robbing us!
